core_obligations: Test K-flatness after restriction (proof lines 3041-3050): for an acyclic complex on the localized site the author tensors it with the restriction of the given complex and compares the result with the restriction of the tensor product over the original site.

Use K-flatness (proof lines 3050-3057): restriction is exact and compatible with tensor products and total complexes, so the acyclicity of the tensor product over the original site implies the acyclicity after restriction, which is the definition of K-flatness for the restricted complex.
proof_roadmap: Compare the total tensor product after restriction with the restriction of the total tensor product.
Use K-flatness of the original complex and exactness of restriction.
Conclude K-flatness of the restricted complex.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that restricting a K-flat complex of modules to a localized site yields a K-flat complex (statement lines 3033-3039). The proof compares the total tensor product computed after restriction with the restriction of the total tensor product computed on the original site (proof lines 3041-3050), and then uses exactness of restriction together with K-flatness of the original complex to transfer acyclicity (proof lines 3050-3057). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two tensor products. The claim is H2: one comparison plus one transfer of acyclicity.
